Forgive me, Nanna

Nanna,

I know I hurt you.

I avoided you when I should have been there.

I disrespected your feelings when I should have protected them.

Sometimes I did not talk to you properly.

Sometimes I failed to understand your emotions.

For every tear, every disappointment, every moment you felt unloved because of me, I am deeply sorry.

You deserved better from me.

You deserved patience, respect, care, and understanding.

I cannot change the past, but I promise to become a better person for our future.

Please forgive me.

My Dearest Nanna... Mummyyy❤️

Naa Nanna... Naa Smile... Naa Life... Naa Pranam...

Nen Ninnu chaala Badha petina Nenu Inka apudu ala cheyanu Maa Nee Pyna Otu nanna.

Nak nee kanna adhi akkuva kadhu nanna Nak Nuv Thapa avaru odhu Mummy.

You are not just a person in my life.

You are my happiness when I am sad.

You are my strength when I am weak.

You are my peace when my mind is restless.

You are my smile when I forget how to smile.

That is why your nickname means so much to me —

because whenever I think of you, I smile.

Whenever I hear your voice, I smile.

Whenever I remember our memories, I smile.

You are not only called Smile... you ARE my smile.

You are my life. You are my Pranam.

You are the reason many of my days became beautiful.

Nanna, I know I made mistakes.

I avoided you when I should have stayed.

I hurt you when I should have protected your heart.

I spoke wrongly when I should have spoken with love and respect. I am truly sorry. Please forgive me.

From today, I promise — I will respect you more, understand you better,

talk to you with love, and never take your love for granted.

I don't want a future without you.

I don't want a life where you are not beside me.

Because you are one of the most precious gifts God has given me.

My Nanna... My Smile... My Life... My Pranam...

I love you more than words can explain.

I choose you today. I choose you tomorrow. I choose you forever.

And no matter what happens, my heart will always belong to you. ❤️

Forever Yours, Srikanth ❤️
